g.text: 4. arrivals-and-ticks, landing lane live, no PR yet

p.strong: Cross-repo reach over three pinned grafana repos.

ul.li: four soopy executors: refs, history, repo_at, dep_crawl
v5 MANIFEST.tsv reproduced without python or shelled git

p.strong: Every v5 builtin mapped to a v6 record or a child issue.

ul.li: 163-rail census, retirement plan names the day src/ stops building
no-new-eprintln and recompute-guard ported to dl6 on the rust door
just v5-rails OK, parity matrix test 4/0

p.strong: The revision is in the host name, never a column.

ul.li: files(glob) reads the worktree, files_at(rev, glob) reads the blob
rulings.pl:544 already said so; the engine had no files_at arm
grafana.sh builds soopy instead of falling back to git cat-file

p.strong: sh, bind and host collapse into one rel form.

ul.li: key() on the column says what identifies an answer
canned golden rows ride --arrive; adapters.json and registry host rows go
executor path spelled /soopy/files per your call; lane applying it now
engine 114 pass / 4 fail: stale tests in live_hosts.rs, lane fixing

g.text: sh files(glob: text) -> (path: text, digest: text)

p.strong: PRs polled by a resident dl6 program, state logged per tick.

ul.li: dl6 run prwatch.dl6 --db prwatch.db, one process over a UDS socket
clock ticks every 60s, GitHub answers 304 with 0 bytes when unchanged
the db also holds the program's own tick cost and RSS
owed: v_lane_proof and v_tick_cost pastes from a 10-minute run

g.text: rel pr_seen(repo, number, state, bucket) log keep(all).
? pr_moved(R, N, From, To, B) order by B desc.
